descriptionChirho: Abstract noun denoting the state or condition of shame, humiliation, or disgrace, covering all grammatical forms with pronominal suffixes and prepositional constructions.
Proper noun usage where בֹּשֶׁת replaces the theophoric element Baal in personal names (e.g., Ish-bosheth for Ish-baal), reflecting later scribal aversion to the divine name Baal.
